products.name: Falcon (TII)
products.note: UAE-hosted open-source LLM; sovereign AI; Apache 2.0; Middle East data residency

profile_text.body:
The Technology Innovation Institute is a non-profit research organization founded in 2020. Its site describes it as a global scientific research center and the applied research pillar of Abu Dhabi's Advanced Technology Research Council (ATRC). Its public work centers on the Falcon family of generative large language models, which the institute presents as making advanced AI accessible and available to everyone, everywhere.

The Falcon family includes several models described on the site. Falcon-H1 and Falcon-E are the most recent additions, with Falcon-H1 built on a hybrid Transformer and Mamba architecture, and Falcon H1R 7B presented as a 7B reasoning model for mathematics, coding, logic and instruction-following. Falcon Arabic targets Modern Standard Arabic and dialects. Falcon Perception is a multimodal model that combines vision and language so systems can interpret images from natural language prompts. Falcon Mamba 7B is described as the first open source State Space Language Model. Earlier releases include Falcon 180B, with 180 billion parameters trained on 3.5 trillion tokens, and Falcon 40B, trained on 40 billion parameters and one trillion tokens and described as the first home-grown open source large language model released with weights for research and commercial use. The institute says Falcon-H1 outperforms Meta's LLaMA and Alibaba's Qwen, and that Falcon 2 11B outperforms Meta's Llama 3 8B and performs on par with Google's Gemma 7B, as independently verified by the Hugging Face Leaderboard. It also announced the Falcon Foundation, a non-profit dedicated to open-source generative AI models, and AI71, launched by ATRC and VentureOne, issued a call for proposals for work using Falcon 10B.

The institute's tracked product is Falcon, described as a UAE-hosted open-source LLM under Apache 2.0 with Middle East data residency. No litigation involving the institute is listed.
